She attempts to fit a large black rectangular tablet into the bag, making a disapproving face as it fails. She then folds the tri-fold smartphone and effortlessly slides it into the same bag, smiling confidently at the camera. (7) The woman stands back in the original studio setting with the grey patterned wall. She continues her presentation with expressive hand motions and pointing gestures. A variety-style text sticker with '老實說' appears briefly near her chest.
